title: GOD MEETS US AT THE THRESHOLD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The Lord said to Moses, 'Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, where I will commission him.' So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the tent of meeting. Then the Lord appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent." — Deut 31:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Moses' life drew to its close and Joshua stood at the threshold of his new calling, God met them both at the tent of meeting. The Lord Himself appeared in the pillar of cloud to commission Joshua. What tender care this shows. At this crucial handover, God did not leave His servants to figure things out alone. He came down and met them personally.

Notice that God speaks plainly of Moses' coming death — "the day of your death is near" — yet there is no panic, no despair. Moses had walked with God long enough to face even his own death within God's care. And God, for His part, was already tending to what came next, personally commissioning the one who would carry on. God's faithfulness spans even the transition between one servant and another.

There is comfort here for us at every threshold and transition. When we stand at the edge of something new and uncertain — a new role, a new season, or even the approach of death itself — God meets us there. He does not abandon us at the doorway. He comes near.

Jesus promised His followers that He would be with them "always, to the very end of the age" (Matt 28:20). And He spoke of preparing a place for us, so that where He is, we may be also (John 14:3). Whatever threshold you face, God will meet you at it. He is the God of every transition, present at every doorway, faithful from one season to the next.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What "threshold" or transition am I facing right now?
2. Do I trust that God will meet me there, as He met Moses and Joshua?
3. How does God's presence change the way I face uncertainty?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You meet me at every threshold and never abandon me at the doorway of change. Be near me in every transition, as You were with Moses and Joshua. I trust Your faithful presence. Amen.
